title: Friend re-launches its AI pendant with a speaker that talks to you, for twice the price
excerpt: The Friend AI pendant is re-launching for $249. Nobody liked it before and protested it advertising on the NYC subway.
content_html:
David Imel

is a technology reporter who has been covering the industry since 2007. He co-hosts the Waveform podcast with MKBHD. A former engineer, he now specializes in topics like computational photography and social media protocols.

Do you remember Friend? The Friend that launched an AI pendant, spent $1.8 million of its $2.5 million in funding to acquire friend.com, and plastered the NYC subway with ads promoting artificial companionship?

Yeah well, if you didn’t remember, Friend is back. And now, it’s twice the price.

Source: Friend

This morning, Friend launched a new ad showing two people talking to their Friend pendants about very personal life problems. It didn’t say it explicitly, but the ad showcased a new feature the pendant now includes: a speaker. Before, Friend would only message back to you, but now, it will talk to you, too. For some reason, the addition of that feature is apparently worth $120, as the originally $129 product now costs $249.

The re-launch comes about nine months after a large Friend protest took place in NYC, where protestors tried to bring attention to our growing dependance on technology. Friend was the obvious target, considering it had spent a boatload of money advertising throughout the city. Its founder, Avi Schiffmann, even posted an image promoting the protest, and showed up to it himself.

Shiffmann posted a tweet of the new ad, calling it “Friend 2.0,” even though the product is still just called “Friend” on its site. Presumably, this is because of the new speaker and the new $10 per month subscription, that lets the pendant remember conversations for longer than 30 days.

I’m sure things will go much better this time.

content_html_zh:
大卫·伊梅尔

是一名科技记者，自2007年以来一直报道该行业。 他与 MKBHD 共同主持波形播客。 他曾是一名工程师，现在专注于计算摄影和社交媒体协议等主题。

你还记得朋友吗？ The Friend 推出了人工智能挂件，斥资 250 万美元中的 180 万美元收购了friend.com，还在纽约地铁上贴满了宣传人工陪伴的广告？

是的，如果你不记得的话，朋友回来了。 而现在，价格是原来的两倍。

来源：朋友

今天早上，Friend 推出了一则新广告，广告中两个人正在与他们的 Friend 吊坠谈论非常个人的生活问题。 虽然没有明确说明，但广告展示了吊坠现在包含的一项新功能：扬声器。 以前，Friend 只会给你回复消息，但现在，它也会和你说话。 由于某种原因，添加该功能显然价值 120 美元，因为最初 129 美元的产品现在售价 249 美元。

此次重新推出是在纽约市发生一场大型“朋友”抗议活动约九个月后，抗议者试图引起人们对我们对技术日益增长的依赖的关注。 考虑到该公司已经花费了大量资金在整个城市做广告，Friend 是显而易见的目标。 其创始人阿维·希夫曼甚至发布了一张宣传抗议活动的图片，并亲自到场。

希夫曼发布了一条新广告的推文，称其为“Friend 2.0”，尽管该产品在其网站上仍仅称为“Friend”。 据推测，这是因为新的扬声器和每月 10 美元的新订阅，可以让吊坠记住对话超过 30 天。

我确信这次事情会好得多。
